column1: # NFTBan — DECLARED LIVE GO TOOLCHAIN PIN POPULATION  (v1.229.4 VAF-0 Stage 2)
# ⛔ HAND-MAINTAINED. READ, NEVER GENERATED FROM THE CURRENT GO VERSION.
#     CURRENT REALITY -> GENERATES EXPECTATION -> VALIDATES CURRENT REALITY
# The VALUE authority is go.mod. This file declares only WHERE live pins live, so a pin
# cannot silently diverge, disappear, or appear unclassified. The initial population was
# captured by a VALUE-INDEPENDENT structural scan (declaration FORM, never the version
# string) and hand-reviewed; from here it is read-only data and drift in EITHER direction
# ⛔ WHY THIS EXISTS. PR-C moved 20 live declarations across 19 files with NO guard. The
# SOFT-COUPLED pins (jobs without GOTOOLCHAIN=local) would have drifted SILENTLY: Go
# auto-upgrades to satisfy go.mod, so a stale pin still goes green.
#     SOFT-COUPLED JOB GREEN != DECLARED PIN COHERENT
# ⛔ LOCATIONS ARE FILE+KEY, NEVER LINE NUMBERS. Line numbers drift with every edit.
# NOT IN THIS POPULATION, by design:
#   * `go-version: ${{ env.GO_VERSION }}`  DERIVED references (ossra x2, socket x1) — they
#     inherit from the GO_VERSION pin declared in the same file, which IS registered.
#   * comments and CHANGELOG history — v1.218.10 genuinely shipped 1.25.12; rewriting that
#     would falsify the record. HISTORICAL REFERENCE != LIVE DECLARATION.
#   * Dockerfile `FROM golang:1.25-alpine` — a deliberate MINOR-level float. It is NOT a
#     patch-level pin and Stage 2 must not pin or redesign it (supply-chain finding PR-C-2).
